searchText: hey guys! is there any wishlist for verkle tree toolings? would like to contribute to this space 🙂 Hey <@606464909907197983>, actually working on putting together an updated list. In the meantime, <@353136597522448385> and <@774033563732541451> or others here might have a few areas to explore. I’d also recommend joining the monthly Verkle Implementers Call to learn more. sure! may I know when is the next meeting being scheduled? Yep! Currently it's scheduled for July 4. And can sign up here to be notified of all future calls: https://forms.gle/b43eWGsJX8do4B967 just received it, thank you 😄 Not sure if you refer to internal tooling for clients (e.g: debugging, observability, etc) or dapp developer tooling. Reg the latter, something that I think can be useful for contract developers is having better understanding on the new gas accounting e.g: code bytecode chunks touched in common txn execution use-cases (maybe compilers can optimize for this with hints?), or understanding how your data access if affecting gas costs (e.g: see if you can pack more things into the same stem) also, something like https://evm.storage/ but for VKT would be nice (i.e: some state explorer) thanks for the pointers, will look into it 🙂 Good point by <@774033563732541451> : we don't really have a state/block explorer for displaying the verkle proofs & the state. I made https://github.com/gballet/verkle-block-explorer last year but it's very bare bones, and ideally we would like to tweak a real block explorer, i.e. adapt one of the existing ones. Nonetheless, this codebase has some really useful features, like the part that takes the proof, reconstructs the tree from it, and generates an image from it.
